name: Cave of Origin
lines: You can hear a voice from within the Aqua Suit!

???: Hey!
You read me, little scamp?

Archie: Aye, it’s me, Archie!
Archie: There’s a device built into
that suit that lets me talk to you.

Archie: We’re getting readings up here
that look as though Kyogre’s appeared.
Archie: I’d guess you’re staring right
at it, if I’m not mistaken!

Archie: Don’t be afraid, scamp!
You leap right onto that beastie’s back!
Archie: Then le— take you to— dee—est...
o— th— c...
